options: Dandeetti afaanii dubbataa fi dhaggeefataan afaan sana irratti qaban.
Namni ergaa dabarsuu fi namoonni ergaan isaan ilaallatu bara fi yeroo garagaraa keessa jiraachuu.
Waliirraa fagaachuu ergaa dabarsaa fi ergaa simataa (distance between them).
questions.explanation: Dandeetti afaanii dubbataa fi dhaggeefataan afaan sana irratti qaban.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Himoota (a) Tolaan gama Naayiroobii deeme fi (b) Tolaan gama Keeniyaa hin deemne jedhaman ilaalchisee dhugaa lafarra jiru keessatti kamtu fudhatamaa miti?
options: (a) n dhugaa yoo ta’e, (b)’n soba ta’
(b) n dhugaa yoo ta’e, (a)’n immoo soba ta’a.
(b) n dhugaa yoo ta’e, (a) nis dhugaa ta’a.
questions.explanation: Hundinuu deebii ta’u.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Kanneen keesaa kamtu amala bargaaffii miti?
questions.explanation: Odeefkennitoonni qorataa waliin walarguun dirqama bargaaffii miti.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Odeefkennitoonni qorataa waliin walarguun dirqama Gaazexaadhaaf yookin galaachaadhaaf, kanneen armaan gadii keessaa isa kamtuu faayidaa mata duree oduu barreesuu miti?
options: Dubbiisaa hawwachuun guutummaa odicha dubbisuuf akka kaka’u gochuudha.
Dubbistonni dursanii waa’ee keessoo odichaa akka quufan godha.
Miira dubbiistoota qirqirsuun keessoo odichaa hawwaatamaa taasisa.
questions.explanation: Miira dubbiistoota qirqirsuun keessoo odichaa hawwaatamaa taasisa faayidaa mata duree oduu barreesuu miti.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Barruu addeessaa barreessuu keessatti waan nu dinqisiise ykn gaddisiise karaa kamiin addeessina?
questions.explanation: Gubbaadhaa gaditti waan nu dinqisiise ykn gaddisiise addeessina.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Dalagaan gulaaltoota kallattii __________ gu laaluu dha?
questions.explanation: Qabiyyee oduu ykn barruu (Content) gu laaluu dha.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Caasaa gaalee keessaa kan hafuu hin dandeenye kami?
questions.explanation: Guuttuu caasaa gaalee keessaa kan hafuu hin dandeenye.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Kanneen armaan gadii keessaa isa kamtu walqunnamtii garee gaggeessuuf hin Barbaachifne dha?
questions.explanation: Yaada amansiisan walqunnamtii garee gaggeessuuf hin barbaachifne.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Mala walqunnamtii afaanii iddoo fi yeroon akka hin daangofne _________ furmaata waaraa ta’eera?
options: Waliigaltee afaanii meeshaalee teeknolojii haaraa fayyadamuu
questions.explanation: Waliigaltee afaanii mala barreefamaatiin furmaata waaraa ta’eera.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Sabaahimaalee Maxxaansaa keessatti Odeeffannoon dabalataa oduu yeroo hundaa guddaa irraa gara xiqqatti adeema.
questions.explanation: Guddina fi salphina odichaatu murteessa.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Dhamsagni jecha irra butaa keessatti dhamsagoota biro dursee dhufu kami?
questions.explanation: /b/ dhamsagoota biro dursee dhufu.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Hundeen jecha garboomfate jedhuu:
questions.explanation: Garb - hundeen jecha garboomfate.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Gaazexeessuummaa maxxansaas ta’ee kan tamsaasaa keessatti haalli filannoo jechoota itti fayyadamnu _________________ dhaan ta’uu qaba?
questions.explanation: Humna ergaa dabarsuu isaanitiin haalli filannoo jechoota.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Kanneen armaan gadii keessaa tokko mallattoo liidii gaarii ti?
options: Miiroota taatee odicha keessaa hanga tokko agarsiisa.
questions.explanation: Guddummaafi barbaachisummaa odichaa agarsiis mallattoo liidii gaarii.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Akka yaaxina______________ tti waloon tokko addunyaa haaraa uumee dhiyeessa.
questions.explanation: Yaaxina ibsaa waloon tokko addunyaa haaraa uumee dhiyeessa.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: Fuulonni gaazexaa tokkoo maal fakkaachuu akka qaban murteessuudhaaf ogeeyyiin gaazeexaa abbuummaadhaan waliin hojjatan isan kami?
options: Qop heessitoota dizaayinii fuula duraa gaazexaa (front page layout designers)
questions.explanation: Gulaaltota qindoomina oduu fuulonni gaazexaa maal fakkaachuu akka qaban murteessuudhaaf.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam

questions.questionText: _______n caaseffama raawwilee diraamaati.
questions.explanation: Waldiddaa caaseffama raawwilee diraamaa.
questions.topic: Afaan Oromo and Literature Exit Exam
